scenarios.description: Audited FY2025 financial information with traceable evidence
FY2025 revenue differs between audited statements and management presentation
Management proposes a legal-fee EBITDA add-back
Largest customer represents 42 percent of revenue
Key customer contract contains a change-of-control termination right
Debt schedule and covenant documents have not been provided
Accrued transaction bonus is identified as a debt-like candidate
Reported net working capital is retained for later analysis
Customer concentration is assessed as high severity
Analyst approval preserves rationale and state transition
